title: Xiaomi 18 Fold surfaces in benchmark, confirming its chipset and RAM amount
description: Xiaomi has already officially confirmed that it's launching the 18 Fold this month, and that the device will be powered by the self-developed Xring O3 chipset, which seems quite impressive. Now the upcoming foldable smartphone has been spotted in the Geekbench AI online database, as a prototype ran the benchmark. The device is powered by the Xring O3 SoC as expected, paired with 16GB of RAM - at least that's how much the prototype in question had. Xiaomi may offer other options too. title: Poco X8 is official with an 8,340 mAh battery and the Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 SoC
description: Today's big Poco launch wasn't all about just the F9 Pro and F9 Ultra. Obviously, the flagships got most of the attention, but the brand has also decided to finally make the 'vanilla' Poco X8 official for global markets, ahead of its Indian launch (where the X8 Power is joining it) in a few days. The Poco X8 lands many months after the Pro and Pro Max, which both launched in March. The 'vanilla' model sports a 6.83-inch AMOLED screen with a 1280x2772 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 3,500-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 SoC. title: Poco F9 Pro and F9 Ultra announced
description: The brand-new Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra share similar designs and specs, though there are enough changes that help the Ultra model stand out. Starting off with the chipset, F9 Ultra brings the top-tier Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip, which has been powering Android flagships for the last twelve months. The F9 Pro gets the recently announced Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V Series (SM8850-1-AB). According to Qualcomm’s own documents, the V series version of the chip features a slightly watered-down GPU. description: Samsung announced the Android 17-based One UI 9 Beta program for the Galaxy S26 series in May, and today, the Korean brand expanded the One UI 9 Beta program to more Galaxy devices in India, South Korea, the US, and the UK. The Galaxy devices eligible for the One UI 9 Beta program include the Galaxy Z Fold7, Galaxy Z Flip7, Galaxy S25, Galaxy S25+, Galaxy S25 Ultra, and Galaxy S25 FE. The press release we received from Samsung doesn't mention the Galaxy S25 Edge, so it's unclear whether it will receive One UI 9 beta or get the stable build directly. title: Tecno will bring a bezelless concept phone to IFA, a laptop with a 360° hinge and more
description: Cheap phones have big bezels around their screens. Premium phones have thinner bezels. And Tecno’s concept phone has no bezels – literally 0mm. Welcome to IFA 2026. The Tecno Next-Gen Bezelless Concept Phone will be presented at the IFA ShowStoppers 2026 event. It uses “advanced internal stacking, structural re-engineering and novel screen packaging that rework the display architecture.” The company also brought three new Megabook laptops to the event. title: Samsung unveils $800 Galaxy Book6 with 14" display and Intel Core 3/5 processors
description: Samsung is adding a new member to the Galaxy Book6 family of laptops today – a new 14” Galaxy Book6. It is a Windows 11 machine (also available with Linux) that starts at $800 / £800 / €850. The laptop has a 14” 16:10 LCD with an anti-glare coating (1,920 x 1,200px resolution, 350 nits brightness). This model measures 15.7mm thick and weighs 1.35kg (2.98lbs). The Samsung Galaxy Book6 has a 14” 16:10 display with an anti-glare coating The laptop has a 61.2Wh battery and promises to last up to 25 hours on a single charge. title: Tim Cook steps down as CEO of Apple, John Ternus takes over
description: Today marks a major turning point for Apple – Tim Cook steps down as CEO and John Ternus takes the reins. Cook has been with Apple since 1998 and became CEO in 2011 after Steve Jobs resigned due to health reasons. The iPhone 5, 5s and 5c were the last models designed with oversight by Jobs. Jobs passed just days after the iPhone 4s was unveiled, but he still influenced the design of the 5-series during its development. Everything after that has been under the guiding hand of Cook. title: Lava makes its UK debut with the launch of Agni 4N
description: Indian handset maker Lava has entered the UK smartphone market with the launch of Agni 4N (Agni means fire). Lava says the Agni 4N is "designed to deliver a premium smartphone experience at an accessible price point" and "combines flagship-grade performance, thoughtful design, and user-centric innovation for UK consumers." The Lava Agni 4N flaunts a metal build and packs a 6.67" AMOLED display with Gorilla Glass 5 protection. description: HMD launched the Asha 305 in July, and now the brand is apparently working on a new device called the Asha 305 Pro. description: According to Honor, the Magic9 series is set to launch in September, with a recent leak suggesting that the company could unveil two models at the event. Tipster Digital Chat Station claims that the upcoming Honor Magic9 Pro, which is expected to be powered by the yet-to-be-announced Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset, will be the first Android phone to feature a 1:1 square front-facing camera sensor. description: The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra (SM-X940) was spotted on Geekbench 7 by Abhishek Yadav. Geekbench 7 results for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra (SM-X940) This doesn’t appear to be a plus version of the chip since its Prime CPU core is clocked at 4.21GHz, which matches the frequency of the original 9500 chip.
